*FREE GUIDE: 📘 The Content Creator's AI Blueprint*  – https://FirstMovers.ai/blueprint/

*1X Neo, the $20,000 humanoid robot housekeeper, sold out 10,000 units in 5 days. The fine print: when it gets stuck, a 1X employee in a VR headset drives it.*

The Hayward factory hit full-scale production in April, yet the first robots off the line went to 1X's own R&D and internal home testing. Meanwhile, *Expert Mode* turns every teleoperated chore inside a real home into *training data* for the model.

What you'll learn:
✅ What Neo can actually do on day one for $20,000
✅ How *Expert Mode* works, plus the face blur and no-go zones
✅ Why the *EQT deal* puts warehouses on the same production line

That $200 million in demand is really a *much smaller number*.
